premise: Pinecone thinks she's plain next to Flower's petals and Caterpillar's dots, nothing to give — until the sun opens her scales and a gust sends her little winged seeds spinning away over the meadow.
inspiration: Andersen's The Fir Tree, turned: the plain one doesn't wait for glory — her gift is already inside her, and it flies off to become a forest.
lesson: Everyone carries something wonderful, even when it doesn't show.
learning: Pine seeds have little wings and spin away on the wind.

en-US.title: Pinecone's Secret Seeds
en-US.text: In the meadow, {flower:enter} Flower opened her eight yellow petals, and {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to flower} Caterpillar crawled up to admire them. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:pulse} "So pretty!" Beside them sat {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to flower} Pinecone, brown and quiet. {pinecone:face sad} [sighs] {pinecone:live talk} "Flower has petals," she said. "Caterpillar has dots. I only have scales." {flower:live talk} [gently] "Just wait for the sun," said Flower. {canvas:sunshine 0.8} Out came the sun, warm and bright. {pinecone:shake 0.3} Pinecone felt her scales loosen… {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} and she opened them wide, like a flower. {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] "Oh!" {canvas:wind 0.7} {sfx:gust} {all:wobble} Then — whoosh! — along came a gust of wind. {pinecone:sparkle} Out from her scales flew tiny seeds, each with one little wing. Spin, spin, spin, away over the meadow! {canvas:wind stop} {caterpillar:live look-up} Caterpillar reared up tall to watch them go. [curious] "What were those?" {flower:face happy} {flower:glow} [happily] "Pine trees," said Flower, "that haven't grown yet." {pinecone:glow} Pinecone didn't only have scales. She was full of trees.

es-ES.title: Las semillas secretas de Piña
es-ES.text: En el prado, {flower:enter} Flor abrió sus ocho pétalos amarillos, y {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to flower} Oruga se acercó despacito a admirarlos. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:pulse} —¡Qué bonitos! A su lado estaba {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to flower} Piña, marrón y callada. {pinecone:face sad} [sighs] {pinecone:live talk} —Flor tiene pétalos —dijo—. Oruga tiene lunares. Y yo, solo escamas. {flower:live talk} [gently] —Tú espera a que salga el sol —dijo Flor. {canvas:sunshine 0.8} Y salió el sol, calentito y brillante. {pinecone:shake 0.3} Piña notó que se le aflojaban las escamas… {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} y las abrió de par en par, como una flor. {caterpillar:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Oh! {canvas:wind 0.7} {sfx:gust} {all:wobble} Entonces… ¡fiuuu!, llegó una ráfaga de viento. {pinecone:sparkle} De entre sus escamas salieron volando semillitas, cada una con su alita. ¡Y venga a dar vueltas, lejos, por encima del prado! {canvas:wind stop} {caterpillar:live look-up} Oruga se estiró bien alta para verlas marchar. [curious] —¿Qué eran? {flower:face happy} {flower:glow} [happily] —Pinos —dijo Flor—, que todavía tienen que crecer. {pinecone:glow} Piña no tenía solo escamas. Estaba llena de árboles.

ja-JP.title: まつぼっくりの ひみつ
ja-JP.text: のはらで、{flower:enter}お花が、きいろい八まいのはなびらをひらきました。{caterpillar:enter}{caterpillar:go to flower}あおむしさんが、もぞもぞ見にきて、{caterpillar:face happy}{caterpillar:pulse}「きれい！」 そのとなりには、{pinecone:enter}{pinecone:go to flower}ちゃいろくて、しずかなまつぼっくり。{pinecone:face sad}[sighs]{pinecone:live talk}「お花には、はなびら。あおむしさんには、てんてん。わたしには、かさだけ」 {flower:live talk}[gently]「お日さまを、まっててごらん」 とお花。{canvas:sunshine 0.8}ぽかぽかのお日さまが、でてきました。{pinecone:shake 0.3}まつぼっくりのかさが、ゆるんで…{pinecone:face happy}{pinecone:live open hold}{sfx:crackle}お花みたいに、ぱあっとひらきました。{caterpillar:face surprised}[gasps]「わあ！」 {canvas:wind 0.7}{sfx:gust}{all:wobble}そこへ、ひゅうっ！かぜがふいてきました。{pinecone:sparkle}かさのあいだから、小さなたねがとびだします。どれにも、小さなはねがひとつ。くるくるくるっと、のはらのむこうへ！{canvas:wind stop}{caterpillar:live look-up}あおむしさんは、せのびして見おくりました。[curious]「いまの、なあに？」 {flower:face happy}{flower:glow}[happily]「まだ大きくなっていない、まつの木よ」 とお花。{pinecone:glow}まつぼっくりにあるのは、かさだけじゃありません。木が、いっぱいつまっていたのです。
